description: Resolve DNS records (A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CNAME) for a domain using Visual Sentinel's public DNS lookup tool. No authentication required.

domain.description: Domain to resolve, e.g. example.com (without protocol).

recordType.description: Optional: limit to one record type. One of: A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CNAME, SOA. Default: all.

name: vs_dns_check
title: Look up DNS records
